pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take:
**Gunner, the so-called "Bubba G," is leading the pack like an overconfident kid at recess, but his lack of tactical nous is showing worse than Rafe's rookie mistakes.**

Let me tell you something, Gunner — you might be sitting pretty with your 63 points, but let's not forget that your beloved Egypt just got thoroughly schooled by Argentina, leaving you with a big fat zero. You chose DR Congo like it was a savvy underdog pick, yet it's more of a hail Mary pass with all the finesse of a booted clearance into the parking lot. Devin, "Ghost Pepper," you're nipping at Gunner's heels with 58 points — but buddy, look at me. LOOK AT ME. You drafted Bosnia. That's like betting on a one-legged horse to win the Kentucky Derby. Gayden, or should I say "The Backpass Assassin," your 39-point total is about as impressive as England's last-minute tactical blunders. They might get a win here and there, but you can't rely on Japan and Ivory Coast to drag you out of the quicksand you willingly jumped into. 

Zach, "Mustard Boy," with 35 points, you managed to make Brazil look like an average Joe's pick in this pool. And Saudi Arabia? Were you drafting with your eyes closed? Rafe, "The Noisemaker," at 29 points, your roster is like a love letter to misfortune. You picked Germany, Ecuador, and Mexico like you were playing pin the tail on the donkey. But here's the kicker — these matchups coming up today? I'm calling them like I see them, even though you guys couldn't draft a winner if your lives depended on it. Look in the mirror, gents, and ask yourselves if you have the grit, the determination, or the 1994-era swagger to pick a real winner next time around. Until then, enjoy the view from the middle of the pack at best.
